create_get_cached_sticker_description: create a call to get_cached_description with a file_unique_id string to retrieve a cached sticker
cache_sticker_description: cache a sticker description by file_unique_id with vision-generated description text and emoji
build_sticker_injection: build a sticker injection string from a description, emoji, and optional set_name
